11.note: The moonwalk's Hasselblad magazine: frames 5844-5970, in the order taken. Anchors tie NASA's captioned frames to the moment the tape has that activity.

anchors.why: Armstrong: "I'll step out and take some of my first pictures here."
NASA caption: Aldrin egressing the LM. Aldrin: "Now I want to back up and partially close the hatch."
NASA caption: Aldrin descends the ladder steps. Armstrong: "Isn't that something! Magnificent sight out here."
NASA caption: Aldrin poses beside the flag. The flag is up at 110:09:43.
NASA caption: Aldrin prepares to deploy the experiments. Aldrin at 110:52:01: "Neil, if you'll take the camera, I'll get to work on the SEQ bay."
Aldrin with the seismic experiment: "I have the seismic experiment flipped over now, and I'm aligning it."
The magazine's last frame, before it was packed: Armstrong at 111:28:12, "I've got the Hasselblad magazine hooked to the SRC now."
